articles.title: Did prediction markets call the U.S. midterm election?: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Prediction markets and polls largely aligned by the end of the 2026 election cycle, and both had notable misses.

articles.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
articles.snippet: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.

articles.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
articles.snippet: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.
